snippet.title: Pixel Washer | Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Pixel Washer on Steam: https://bit.ly/Pixel_Washer_YT

Meet Pigxel, the cleanest pig in gaming. 🐷💦

Pixel Washer launches into early access on October 15, 2026 on PC via Steam!

In Pixel Washer, dirt is the enemy and Pigxel is here to scrub every last pixel clean.

Pigxel isn't your ordinary pig. While the rest of his family loves playing in the dirt, Pigxel would rather clean it. After being kicked out for being a little too clean, he does the only sensible thing: starts his own cleaning business.

Take on filthy jobs, blast away grime, upgrade your equipment and your ride, and grow Pigxel's Pixel Washing business one satisfying cleanup at a time.

If you love satisfying cleaning games, pixel art, indie games, and watching filthy spaces become spotless, Pixel Washer is for you.

Launching into Early Access on October 15, 2026. 

Every pixel can be cleaner.

#PixelWasher #IndieGame #PixelArt #CleaningGames #PowerWashSimulator #Gaming
